newsitem.title: UK: Next says current sales 14 pct up on last yr.
newsitem.headline: Next says current sales 14 pct up on last yr.

text.p: Clothing retailer Next Plc said sales in its stores were 14 percent higher than the previous year in the five weeks from August 12, on selling space five percent higher.
Sales in Next Directory, its mail order business, were 20 percent higher than last year.
Next said that sales for the first two weeks of the autumn/winter season this year were not comparable with last year because it delayed its spring/summer sale by two weeks until the end of July.

It reported first half pretax profits of 56.0 million stg, up from 50.1 million a year ago, which included a 6.0 million stg exceptional gain from the sale of a non-trading business. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
